metadata.name: FuelEconomy.gov 2026 Maserati models missing from vPIC
metadata.description: 2026 Maserati model names listed as distinct models by the DOE/EPA FuelEconomy.gov catalog but not present in the current vPIC snapshot for any year: GT2 Stradale (record 50273) and MCPura Spyder (record 50274). The 2026 MCPura itself is already in vPIC and arrives via the NHTSA source refresh. Verified via the public FuelEconomy.gov model-year menu API.
